purpose: Shows one number per day over a year as a grid of shaded squares, for contribution and habit calendars. Reach for it when the pattern across days and weeks matters more than exact values.

notFor.case: One value over time, read as a trend.
Exact values the person must read and compare.

Default.visual: 53 × 7 cells on the Chart/sequential ladder; month, day and Less–More legend labels in Content/secondary.

a11y.keyboard: One roving tab stop. ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move one week, ArrowUp / ArrowDown one day, Home / End the first / last day of the week, Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End the first / last day of the grid.
notes: 7 rows (weekdays) of gridcells; every cell is named by its day and count (getCellLabel), so the level never relies on colour alone.
The legend, month and day labels are decorative (aria-hidden).
The focused day is shown by the consumer through onFocusDay; there is no built-in tooltip.

openQuestions: The contract has no Figma set linked (finding DOC-001, codeOnly). Should the set be added to the inventory?
Empty and loading data: is an all-zero grid enough, or does the heatmap need its own empty or loading treatment?
